title: EXP-102 - Hello World Part 7 Sections 1-2: Flex Form FX_CustomerPortal (Flex > Basic, Unit Character), Primary Collection FX_Orders, Secondary Collection FX_Items, One Regenerate Form, Readback After Reopen
objective: Follow hello-world-pt7.md Sections 1 and 2 (00:44-04:10), adapted to FX_ names and User scope: in the Web Designer use New Form Definition with Category Flex and Wizard Basic to create the Form FX_CustomerPortal with Form Unit Character, recording the wizard read-only first. Then in the Details > Collections tab set the Primary Collection to the IDO FX_Orders and add a Secondary Collection FX_Items, and invoke Regenerate Form exactly once (operator-authorized for FX_CustomerPortal only; the narrator describes it as Save + Close + Reopen). Verify the Form, its automatically added Flex Layout component and both collections after an ordinary close and reopen. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Before browser interaction read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt7.md Sections 1 and 2 (lines 109-131) and 'Sequence-sensitive checks' item 9, recipes/forms/create-basic-form.md, recipes/session/session-expiry-and-stale-designer.md, and only the final Outcome (operator) sections of the EXP-041-R3 and EXP-101 records. Do not read those records in full and do not read later Part 7 sections.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-102-hello-world-part-7-sections-1-2-fx-customer-portal-form.md and evidence/EXP-102/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task; never sign in inside the portal's embedded app frame (refused, EXP-080-R2) but use the procedure's top-level portal navigation. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Answer any prompt within the same task; never leave a prompt, menu or unsaved change open across tasks, except that the newly created FX_CustomerPortal may stay open in the Designer between T2 and T3 if it is clean (Save disabled). After any pause, inspect the state read-only before acting and never replay an earlier action.
Task boundary: do only what the current task instruction lists and stop at its end, even when later steps of this brief remain; report the next step instead of performing it.

Editing scope: stay in User scope throughout. The tutorial's Site Default scope is not authorized; if an 'Identify Your Editing Scope' dialog appears, confirm it shows User for the signed-in user and accept it unchanged; if it shows any other scope, Cancel it and stop blocked.

Designer gate (read-only): User scope, no Form dirty (Save disabled), no dialog open. If a clean Form other than FX_CustomerPortal is open, it may be closed once through its Form-tab control (fresh snapshot before the click; answer No to any save prompt and record its text).

Absence check (read-only): through the Designer's Open (Select Form) dialog, look for FX_CustomerPortal and, as a positive control, FX_Orders; scroll or filter the list as needed, never use OK (it activates a row) and never double-click a row in T1. Record the result with a screenshot and leave the dialog with Cancel or its close control. If FX_CustomerPortal exists, record it and stop blocked.

Wizard discovery (read-only): click New Form Definition once. In 'Form Wizard Selection' record every control, the Category options and, after selecting Category Flex, the Wizard options with their descriptions. Selecting a Category or Wizard value in this dialog is allowed; do not click OK in T1. Leave with Cancel once and record the Designer state.

Create the Form (T2): New Form Definition once, New Form, Category Flex, Wizard Basic, OK once. On every wizard page record every field with its exact label and default before changing anything. Set Name to FX_CustomerPortal (one plain fill, as in EXP-041-R2/R3; at most one correction) and Form Unit to Character; leave every other field at its default. If a 'Save Template' checkbox is present and checked, uncheck it (recipe create-basic-form.md: it creates a template artifact) and record that. Use Next and Finish as the wizard requires, each at most once per page; record every response or completion message verbatim and answer an informational completion message with OK. Verify the Designer shows FX_CustomerPortal open in User scope, record the Form Properties (Name, Version, Form Type, Device Type, unit if shown) and the component tree, including the automatically added Flex Layout component and its name. Record whether Save is enabled. Do not add, move, rename or edit any component.

Collections and Regenerate (T3): with FX_CustomerPortal active and clean, open the Details pane at the bottom and its Collections tab; record every control and the current collection entries before changing anything. Set Primary Collection to the IDO FX_Orders (record whether the control is a list, a text box or a picker; at most one correction). Record any prompt verbatim with its buttons. Then use the Collections New control once and set the new entry as Secondary Collection with IDO FX_Items (record the fields; at most one correction per field). Record any prompt verbatim. Prompt rule: answer a purely informational prompt with OK; if a prompt offers to regenerate now, decline it (No or Cancel) and use the toolbar Regenerate Form instead; if a prompt's meaning is unclear or it would delete, discard or replace anything, choose No or Cancel, record it and stop blocked. Then click the Designer toolbar Regenerate Form exactly once with FX_CustomerPortal active, and record every response and prompt verbatim, the Form that is open afterwards, the Save state and the Collections tab. If an error appears, record it and stop; never repeat Regenerate.

Readback (T4, read-only except the close and reopen): close the clean FX_CustomerPortal once through its Form-tab control (answer No to any save prompt, record its text), then reopen it once through the Designer Form menu recent-forms entry or the Open (Select Form) dialog by double-clicking its exact row (never OK). Record Properties (Name, Version), the component tree with the Flex Layout component, and the Details > Collections entries (Primary FX_Orders, Secondary FX_Items) with screenshots. Leave FX_CustomerPortal open and clean (Save disabled), no dialog open.

Capture screenshots of the Designer gate, the absence check, the Form Wizard Selection with the Flex category and its wizard list, every wizard page before and after filling, the completion message, the new Form with its component tree and Properties, the Collections tab before and after each collection, every prompt, the Regenerate response and the post-Regenerate state, and the readback. Use a distinct filename for every capture; never overwrite an earlier screenshot.

Before every click, use references from the most recent snapshot taken in the current task (not references taken from find output); after any timeout or 'Ref not found', take one fresh untargeted snapshot and use only its references. Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. ExtJS comboboxes are not <select> elements (EXP-101): open their list and click the option. Classify findings as observed only.

notes: Proposed by the operator assistant after EXP-101. Tutorial mapping: Customer Portal -> FX_CustomerPortal; Orders IDO -> FX_Orders; Items IDO -> FX_Items (both factory IDOs from Parts 4-5). The Flex Form is built in the Web Designer through New Form Definition > Category Flex > Wizard Basic (transcript 00:50-00:56), the same Designer used for Classic Forms, so it is within the AGENTS.md scope (Web Designer, Classic Mongoose Forms with FlexLayout components) and the Hello World extension; it is not the Responsive Form Builder. The tutorial's Site Default scope is replaced by User scope (AGENTS.md: Forms stay in User editing scope). The narrator says the collection change raises a prompt to regenerate and the second prompt is acknowledged with OK; the prompt rule declines any regenerate-now offer and uses the toolbar button instead, so Regenerate stays one controlled click.
